description: Validate a local .html, .htm, .css, .json, .xml or .svg file by path, without reading it into the conversation. No key needed. The file is sent to validatehtml.com and not stored. status is 'failed' only on errors, which are spec violations. Warnings are best practices on valid code: mention them, do not treat them as failures.

language.description: Defaults to the file extension. Use 'accessibility' to check an HTML file for WCAG issues.

name: validate_file
